module_title: Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) & NIPUN Bharat Mission
introduction: This foundational level introduces the most critical educational mission launched under NEP 2020: NIPUN Bharat. It defines Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN), the exact target years, and the target age group, which are guaranteed, high-frequency questions in teaching exams.

core_concepts.title: The NIPUN Bharat Mission
core_concepts.description:
Launched on July 5, 2021, by the Ministry of Education. 
- Full Form: National Initiative for Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy.
- Core Vision: To ensure that every child in the country necessarily attains Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) by the end of Grade 3.
- Target Year: **2026-27**.
- Target Age Group: Children aged **3 to 9 years** (from Preschool/Balvatika to Grade 3).

core_concepts.title: What is Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN)?
core_concepts.description:
NEP 2020 declares FLN as an 'urgent and necessary prerequisite to learning.' If a child falls behind in Grade 3, they get left behind entirely, because Grade 3 is the pivot point where children shift from 'learning to read' to 'reading to learn'.
1. Foundational Literacy: The ability to read and comprehend basic text, and write with purpose.
2. Foundational Numeracy: The ability to reason, and apply simple numerical concepts (number sense, addition, subtraction) in daily life.

core_concepts.title: The 5-Tier Implementation Mechanism
core_concepts.description:
To ensure the mission does not fail at the grassroots, a strict 5-tier administrative structure has been set up:
1. National Level (Ministry of Education)
2. State Level
3. District Level
4. Block / Cluster Level
5. School / Community Level (SMC)

core_concepts.title: Why NIPUN?
core_concepts.description: Prior to NEP 2020, the education system focused heavily on school access and enrollment. NIPUN shifts the focus entirely from mere 'schooling' to measurable 'learning outcomes', recognizing that sitting in a classroom is useless if the child cannot read basic words.

important_entities.name: Target Year: 2026-27
important_entities.key_fact: The official deadline for achieving universal FLN.
important_entities.significance: A major exam trap! While the original NEP 2020 document mentioned achieving FLN by 2025, the official NIPUN Bharat Mission document officially set the target year as **2026-27** to account for the pandemic's impact. Always choose 2026-27 for NIPUN-specific questions.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Examiners will ask: 'NIPUN Bharat aims to achieve foundational skills by which grade?' The options will be Grade 2, Grade 3, Grade 5, or Grade 8. The correct and absolute answer is **Grade 3**. Do not confuse this with early childhood care alone.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Break the acronym down visually: **N**ational **I**nitiative for **P**roficiency in reading with **U**nderstanding and **N**umeracy. Never select options that say 'Program' instead of 'Proficiency'.

exam_strategy_tips: If a question asks 'What is the highest priority of the National Education Policy 2020?', the answer is always **Achieving Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN)**. NEP explicitly states that all other policies are irrelevant if this basic foundation is not achieved.
